title: Idle load-to-use latency by access path
conventions: Idle (unloaded) latency. Platforms differ across sources; compare within a row. 'measured' rows come from hardware; 'estimate'/'modelled' rows are spec or model sums and are drawn hollow. lo_ns/hi_ns null with open_ended=true means lower bound only. Rows: sorted fastest first; points_detail lists every dot with its own source; in_brief=false marks extra values not requested in BRIEF.

extraction.method: Printed numbers read with pdftotext -layout from full-text PDFs in fulltext/; arXiv Octopus, Das Sharma, Xeon Max, Melody (VT), Vistara (ISCA'26 camera-ready) and Chips and Cheese HTML fetched into fulltext/. No values read from plot pixels except the Xeon Max note in caveats.

cross_check.resolved: NVMe bar = 10-40 us (TPP Fig.2, printed); 50 us end FULL TEXT NEEDED (both). Pond 155-180 = modelled (Berger Fig.3 component sum). Berger 270/345 are lower bounds. First-hop CXL adder measured +115-155 (Octopus), +120 (Vistara), +119 (PolarCXLMem), up to +280 (Melody vs 114 ns local). Switch adder derived 284-305 ns (PolarCXLMem). Xeon Max absolute ns not printed (A: Fig.3 linear read ~98 vs ~122 ns, single read -> not plotted). | ROUND-1 REVIEW (accuracy B1): first-hop adder corrected to +~100-280 ns measured (Melody CXL-A 214-114=+100; production-type controllers +100-160; +280 from an FPGA device). Switch >=220 ns is [V] XConn via Octopus.

caveats: Xeon Max (arXiv 2505.14294): absolute HBM vs DDR latency is NOT printed. Fig. 3 (linear y axis, latency vs window size) only shows curves; eyeballed plateau at 2^19 kB window is ~98 ns DDR and ~122 ns HBM (chart read, +/-4 ns, includes TLB/window effects, ~+24%). Row left out of the ladder; slide keeps the relative callout (text: 'about 20% higher'; 700 vs 200 GB/s is stated in the intro).
NVMe upper end 50 us: FULL TEXT NEEDED (Micron spec). TPP prints 10-40 us.
Pond 155-180 ns: these numbers are printed in Berger/IEEE Micro Fig. 3 (and a Pond-ASPLOS figure label for 8-socket 155 ns), computed from component latencies, not measured.
Octopus is the arXiv v (10-page) version; NSDI'26 camera-ready not compared.
Vistara 130/250 are printed as approximate ('~'). Grace and H100/GH200 are [S] (Chips and Cheese), approximate.
MemChannel 220.5 ns switched figure intentionally excluded (BRIEF FLAG G4).
